object.attr: derived: the Traceability section counts against the parents in the working copy, and MELLON-PDF-SRS-90 marks only the document (CF-P14; D-P2). Chosen over widening MELLON-PDF-SRS-90 to parents (review Q19), because it says which part of the PDF is a draft.
object.description: When a parent document has an uncommitted document file, the cover page shall state that the Traceability section includes uncommitted changes.
